atthāya.cp: dat. of attha. for the sake of, Kilamatthāya = what for?

D: Atthāya，（attha 的【与】），…为…起见。 Kimatthāya = 为何目的？什么为？（p10）
F: Atthāya，（attha 的【与】），…为…起见。Kimatthāya = 为何目的？什么为？
C: atthāya：[dat．of attha] for the sake of，Kilamatthāya = what for？ atthi ：[as + a + ti] to be; to exist．
I: atthāya：For the good of; in order to，on account of，for the sake of，
U: ATTHĀYA：từ aṭṭha，vì lý do; kimaṭṭhaya chi vậy，cái gì ？
DOP: 1 atthāya sg. dat. of attha 2 qv .
CPD: atthāya , abs. [ sa. āsthāya, ā + √sthā], standing on ( or by, taking care for ) ; using, employing ( acc ); Ja V 353, 3 * (uttama-javam ~, Ed. °javamattāya, C k atthāya, B d and S e anvāya; cf. Ct. uttamena javena gantvā; Ja lV 293, 3 * ( construction not clear; Ct.: tesaṃ atthāya, where atthāya is dat. of 2 attha, q. v.; thus atthāya . . . putte = puttānam atthāya).
NCP: dat. | atthaaya for the benefit of; for the sake of (gen.) See also: attha
